title: Erasing a Landmark
summary:
BMW Toronto operated beside the foot of the Don Valley Parkway out of 11 Sunlight Park Road for over 20 years. With the dealership now moved, the building is coming down so that a flood protection berm can be built between the Don River and the Lower Don Lands, opening up much of Toronto's Port Lands to redevelopment.
